title: Old but Symmetrical Diamonds
description: this resource pack is meant to bring back the old diamonds with symmetry in the shape, just like the current diamond texture
body:
this is meant to add back the old diamonds but with symmetry in the shape, the old texture just BOTHERS me

so if you like the old diamond texture but are bothered by the asymmetry, then get this pack!

if the pack says its incompatible just turn it on anyway, the pack still works.. atleast for me it does
